stance_rationale: Phase-A design materials are coherent enough to frame a Forge test, but the package is not yet verifiable under the alpha critic checklist: required time-series alpha, weights, covariance, challenge-note, and empirical diagnostics artifacts are absent. The weakest point is not the idea itself; it is the attempt to obtain G9/Codex clearance while all PIT, RF-A, AUC-uplift, and integration claims remain protocol-only.

rank_ic.evidence: No rank_IC artifact; package marks stock-level IC as not applicable because SEFRS is regime_feature_only.

icir.evidence: No ICIR artifact; package says Forge will measure later.

harvey_t.evidence: alpha_package_draft diagnostics has harvey_t_count=0 marker, not measured t_NW.

sub_stability.evidence: Subperiod stability is specified as future 5-window AUC, not measured.

dsr.evidence: No DSR value or artifact found.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: Required alpha_scores.parquet path qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260518_001/alpha_scores.parquet is missing, and stage_artifacts/WT_D20260518_001/sefrs_features.parquet is also TBD. weights.csv and covariance.parquet are missing, so schedule, PSD, and condition-number checks cannot be performed.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: No NEGATE_FACTORS or FLIP_SIGN usage found; SEFRS uses custom ETF-flow rolling z-scores rather than Factor DB Z_Score_Aligned. This is acceptable only if the Forge implementation keeps sign conventions explicit.
Usable_Date <= sig_date is protocol-only. No sefrs_features.parquet, publish_timestamp metadata, or implementation audit exists.
Factor DB is not used for SEFRS feature construction, so direct load_month_factors() compliance is not triggered; DPL-RC inherited features still require separate Forge re-audit.
Feature specs mention m4_regime_state_t and other regime interactions, but no current artifact proves t-1 overlay lag or STR_1715 lineage alignment.
No financial statement fields are used in the SEFRS feature set.

critical_concerns.description: Required verification artifacts are absent: alpha_scores.parquet, weights.csv, covariance.parquet, factor_engine_proposal.R, challenge_note.md, and artifact_lineage are not present for WT-D20260518_001, so RF-A7, time-series schedule, PSD/condition, and No Silent Override checks cannot pass.

The package treats 'regime feature only' as a reason to bypass alpha diagnostics, but still asks for Codex G9 pass before empirical Forge. That is a process shortcut unless the approval is explicitly limited to protocol design, not alpha admission.

SEIBro publish timing is unresolved. The protocol assumes t data are published t+1 18:00 KST, while several features use t-1 shares/NAV/TVA/close; without exact decision timestamp and publish metadata, same-period leakage remains open.

The KR empirical narrative is article-level context, not predictive evidence. Seoul Economic Daily articles support that inverse ETF retail crowding/losses occurred, but they do not prove that SEFRS predicts STR_1715 bad states OOS.

Multiple-testing risk is large: 12 features, multiple labels, event-study choices, logistic/EN/LightGBM paths, OR-gates for AUC/uplift, and feature-subset retries are specified, but no Harvey t, DSR, or pre-registered selection log result exists.

AX-005 and AX-007 avoidance is premature. A regime feature injected into DPL-RC can still affect the final top-20 long-only portfolio; multi-sleeve/ML-sizing exemption must be proven by actual integration weights, bad-state alpha, MDD relief, and bad/normal IC ratio.

Current metadata are future-dated relative to critique time: package and stage docs use 2026-05-18, while the environment timestamp is 2026-05-17T16:17:06+09:00. The 'last sig_date <= today' check cannot be satisfied from these artifacts.
Data feasibility is not yet feasibility evidence. The local audit says ETF daily shares/NAV/AUM/TVA are absent and collector code is nonexistent; API availability and coverage remain assumptions.

supporting_arguments: The feature design does explicitly prefer t-2 NAV and rolling windows t-60..t-1, which is the right PIT direction if implemented exactly.

The literature package cites core ETF-flow and ETF-volatility mechanisms, and the two KR media claims checked via web are present: https://en.sedaily.com/finance/2026/05/17/kospi-hits-8000-but-retail-investors-bet-34-trillion-won-on and https://en.sedaily.com/finance/2026/03/20/999-percent-of-korean-retail-investors-in-leveraged-inverse.
The Forge protocol contains hard abort gates for data coverage, PIT audit failure, event-study failure, and DPL-RC uplift failure; those gates should remain mandatory before any admission claim.
unresolved_disputes: Whether this review is meant to approve only Phase-A design documentation or to approve alpha admission readiness.
Whether SEFRS feature Date means decision-at-open, decision-at-close, or next-session application after SEIBro publish.
Whether the 80-feature DPL-RC baseline and feature_allowlist_v2 lineage are in-scope for this WT or inherited from WT-D20260517_003.
Whether lockbox/paper-trade exclusion is enforced by code rather than by narrative fields.
weakest_assumption: The most fragile claim is that 'regime_feature_only_NOT_alpha_sleeve' lets SEFRS bypass alpha time-series and AX-007 checks while still receiving G9 Codex clearance for DPL-RC production-feature injection.
rebuttal_required: Produce sefrs_features.parquet with Date x feature columns, publish_timestamp metadata, n_sig_dates, and no future dates.
Produce PIT audit result proving Usable_Date <= sig_date for every SEIBro/KRX input and m4 interaction.
Produce event_study_decile_result, walk_forward_oos_metrics, DPL-RC 80-vs-88 AUC/Brier comparison, and method-shopping log.
Produce weights.csv and covariance.parquet only if this WT is being judged as an alpha package rather than design-only protocol.
Add challenge_note.md and artifact_lineage.json before final alpha_package.json.
rationalization_red_flags: Exact base-context prohibited phrases appear only inside blacklist/grep sections, not as substantive justification: 영향 미미, 관행적 허용, 보수적이면 괜찮다, 대부분 결과 동일, 이미 반영되어 있었을 것, 백테스트 기간이 충분히 길어서 상쇄.
Deferral phrases requiring scrutiny: TBD at Forge, design phase A, Q-Lead confirm 후, 코드 작성 X, 현 인프라 부재.
Potential overclaim phrases: empirical 입증, 충분히 robust, Audit complete, integration ready.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: No Forge or Architect PASS exists for WT-D20260518_001, and local artifacts are design documents only. Treat any approval as permission to run Forge, not as alpha admission.

alpha_specific_questions: 이 factor가 KR market에서 t_NW > 2.95를 fund-of-fund 환경에서 유지할 수 있는가?
alpha vector 시계열에 future leakage 없는가? 특히 SEIBro publish timestamp와 m4_regime_state lag.
AX-axiom EXCLUSION에 의존하는 가설이라면 EXCLUSION 충족이 necessary AND sufficient한가?
DPL-RC 80→88 feature injection이 Brier score를 악화시키지 않으면서 5-window OOS ΔAUC ≥ 0.01을 유지하는가?
